title: Perfect start to our trip
text:

We covered so much ground in the Gothic district and more, getting our bearings and learning some of the main points of the history and particular culture of Barcelona. She was generous with her time and so enthusiastic about all there is to see and do in Barcelona!

title: Highly Recommend!
text: Each new city I go to I seek out a tour to kick off the trip so that I get the lay of the land and an introduction to the history and culture. I spent a lot of time looking for the right tour to take in Barcelona, and I am super happy with this tour and specifically Fred, our tour guide. He was super knowledgeable and enthusiastic and was fun to hang out with as well. It felt more like a friend was showing us around rather than us being on a tour. title: Fred was a great tour guide
text: Fred was great. Right on time and communicated with us well. He went at our pace and was very knowledgeable and informative.  He pointed out lots of little details we would have missed on our own.  It was a fun morning!
author: Laurie_C

title: Great experience
text: Loved exploring the Gothic Quarter. Small quiet streets and alleys and learned a lot about the history of the city too.
author: Kristina_O

title: Andy is the hidden gem
text: Andy is the perfect tour guide, he was very knowledgeable and in tune with our interests.  He had great stories and showed us things we would never have know about or found in guide books.  It’s obvious he takes great joy in his job and he worked hard to ensure we had a great experience.  This combined with his wit and great sense of humor made for a fantastic tour and experience.
author: nafzgerd

title: Money well-spent
text: There are numerous group and private tour operators in the city, and I looked at many descriptions on Expedia and Viator to find one that did more than the obvious sights you can manage on your own. I found Andy at Barcelona Boutique Tours and was very happy with him. He took me into places I might have walked by just because an alley did not look inviting but not knowing that at the other end was a building or plaza.
